description_en: Queries the file information of a file transmission task
description_zh: 查询传输任务的文件信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd list-transfer-files --task-id trt-03tdwg4tcuwdzv0000 --max-results 20 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f00000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransferFiles

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transmission task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

IconUrl.description_en:
The URL of the file icon.



For image file types (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp, and .svg), the URL of the specific image is returned.

For other file types, the URL of the default image is returned
IconUrl.description_zh:
文件图标地址。 

图片类型文件(png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp, svg)会返回图片访问地址
其他类型文件会返回默认图片地址

OssFileName.description_en:
The name of the object stored in OSS.



A value is returned for this parameter only when the object is stored in a custom OSS bucket
OssFileName.description_zh:
存储在OSS中的文件名称。

仅在自定义bucket时返回

OssFilePath.description_en:
The path of the object in the OSS bucket.



A value is returned for this parameter only when the object is stored in a custom OSS bucket
OssFilePath.description_zh:
存储在OSS中的文件路径。

仅在自定义bucket时返回

Status.description_en:
The file status.

Valid values:

DELETING

DELETED

UPLOADED

MaxResults.description_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：20

NextToken.description_en: The returned value of `NextToken` is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，`NextToken`为空表示没有下一个
